author: Home Repair Tutor
description: Shower wall outside corners should be protected. I’m using a metal profile for both sides of this half wall. I like cutting them on a miter saw for a smooth finish. The Ironclad Command A9 PU gloves I’m wearing are invaluable when cutting any type of metal, I highly recommend them.
title: Shower Wall Outside Corner Tips - #tileshower #showerremodel #sponsored
